caption:
"Sorry, can I ask a question?" "Sorry for the long text." None of those needed an apology. Your brain uses "sorry" to soften your presence before anyone can be bothered by it. The Apology Audit shows you the pattern. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#overthinking #anxiety #peoplepleasing #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: you said sorry six times today — you didn't do anything wrong
